preservedBase.membershipRule: Existing ordinary tasks default to V1; migration must prove the literal original27 set including ten POCs. Reject moving, omitting, duplicating or relabeling those members into the follow-up scope. Normal lifecycle and precisely authorized future planned-definition edits remain governed by existing rules.
preservedBase.scopeClosureRule: GZ-020 retains its original V1 final role, definition and production obligations; only the frozen27 V1 membership belongs to that final closure. AGENT-EDGE-104 has its own future final task and cannot discharge, replace or silently extend GZ-020.

fixedMechanismBoundary.representation: One optional Program.scopeBoundary object, fixed v1TaskIds/v1FinalTask plus exactly one agentEdge104 object; task membership is explicit there. GZ-022 retains the existing closed Task field set; no Task.scope property is needed.
fixedMechanismBoundary.initialPlanningAdmission: Only normally reserved GZ-022 may execute planning in the new scope after OPS-011 is actually completed and accepted; no new business consumer may reserve/start/continue from planning state.
fixedMechanismBoundary.planningIsNotCompletion: A scope with requiredFinalTask=null is not execution-ready or complete. Completing GZ-022 alone cannot complete AGENT-EDGE-104.
futureGz022OriginalDeclarationMustContai: At GZ-022 original reservation, freeze exact full before/after for the planning-to-defined scope transaction, all new complete planned business Task definitions, real scoped requirements/acceptance records, exact taskIds and a non-null final release/acceptance Task ID.
Require the final task to transitively close every in-scope task; reject empty scope, missing members, duplicates, cycles, undeclared consumer, missing final task and later unregistered expansion.

Declare only actually unstarted amendments among GZ-006/007/008/011/012/013/016/018 with complete original-definition fingerprints and exact allowed fields/before/after. Re-read their actual original reservation base; do not freeze speculative edits now.

Declare a complete planning baseline produced by GZ-022 and all exact downstream consumer roots so business reservation/execution waits for its actual normal accepted Completion main, even if a same-PR Program row claims completion.

Declare actual cross-scope dependsOn, contract producers/consumers and baseline barriers; a scope label never bypasses a dependency, contract, authorization, global capacity or critical-standalone rule.

Use only the fixed follow-up declaration path/format authorized by OPS-011 for planning-to-defined changes; preserve all legacy v1 manifest structure, closed Task/REQ rules and original-byte meaning, including cross-file references.
fixedMechanismBoundary.scopedRequirementsPolicy: New requirement identifiers belong only to AGENT-EDGE-104 and its exact requirementIndex; no individual new identifier is allocated here. Keep the legacy requirements-index.yaml exactly ten V1 requirements and old V1 machine artifacts unchanged. The new fixed scoped requirement/acceptance catalogs are authored by GZ-022, and existing claimed schema/readiness/Task/planning entry points must validate their identity, module symmetry, coverage and final closure.
fixedMechanismBoundary.waveRule: Enforce wave activation within the explicit fixed scopes while preserving actual cross-scope dependency wave ordering, contract ancestry and baseline barriers. Reuse existing W IDs; this first use changes no waves.
fixedMechanismBoundary.capacityRule: One global Registry and unchanged maxActiveTasks=3/maxHighRiskTasks=1/criticalStandalone across both scopes; no per-scope duplicate lease or independent capacity pool.
fixedMechanismBoundary.externalRepositoryRule: No ../ or foreign-repository claim. Each external runtime repository needs its own normal governance; Guize tracks exact version composition and joint acceptance without creating a universal cross-repository Registry.
